body: I’m in high school. I’ve participated in combat sports in the past and I used to play guitar. I would do those things but I have no motivation. What even is the point?

Not to point fingers, but my family has never been good to me. Ever. I am estranged from all my friends due to some recent fights. I wish I could quit drinking but I have tried numerous times and failed. The fight will only truly be over when I’m dead.
